description: *Makes the Command ability cost 1 fewer Command Charge. Minimum cost is still 1.* $182, to be exact. Creates: Wad of Cash Source: Sold by the [Vendor](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953210) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 1).

title: Blueprint: Untapped Golden Earrings
description: *Boosts Falter by +20%. However, Damage is decreased by -30%.* The stone in the center shines green and purple in the right light. Creates: Golden Earrings Source: Reward for defeating [The Underpass Resonant](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953962).

title: Blueprint: Untapped Framing Hammer
description: *Combat Abilities will deal +30% Falter but no Damage at all.* A heavy duty hammer used for construction. Standard issue. Creates: Framing Hammer Source: Sold by the [Vendor](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953211) for 1000 Source (Vendor Level 1).

title: Blueprint: Untapped Old Subway Card
description: *Significantly increases Rush duration.* I wonder if I can still use this, maybe find some of Jesse's favorite spots in the city. Creates: Old Subway Card Source: Reward for defeating the Hiss Collider Apex encounter.

title: Blueprint: Untapped Shiny Pebble
description: *Slowly restores Health up to 50% while using a Gravity Anomaly.* I used to love finding quartz and pretty stones to give to mom. Creates: Shiny Pebble Source: Reward for completing the Freeze Frame mini-quest chain.

title: Blueprint: Untapped Whetstone
description: *Add +20% Damage for all Melee attacks and Combat Abilities, but Falter will be reduced by 20%.* Dad had one of these too. He used it a lot to sharpen his hunting knife. Creates: Whetstone Source: Reward for completing A New Directive.

title: Lit Sparkler
description: *A Perfect Dodge will cause Dylan's next Dodge to create an explosive charge, dealing Fire Damage to nearby enemies.* Is this going to burn a hole in my pocket? Source: Granted by the Downtown district upgrade "Artifact".

title: Wallet
description: *Combat Abilities consume Health when out of Power. Health cannot drop below 5% from this Artifact.* I should probably turn this in once this is over. I hope whoever it belongs to is still out there. Source: Granted by the Central district upgrade "Artifact".

title: Blueprint: Untapped Worn Eraser
description: *Gives Dylan significant resistance to all negative status effects by increasing the time it takes for them to build up.* If only all mistakes were easy to undo. Creates: Worn Eraser Source: Reward for completing Fight to the Core.

title: Energy Drink
description: *Adds +30% Critical Chance for all melee attacks when Dylan is at maximum Health. Dylan takes +20% more damage while this Artifact is equipped.* Darling let me have one of these to see if it affected my abilities. My hands were shaking for hours. Source: Granted by the Twisted City district upgrade "Artifact".

title: Blueprint: Untapped Compact
description: *Critical Hits deal +50% more Damage. However, they deal 30% less Falter.* I used to watch my mom put her makeup on all the time, before she stopped going out. Creates: Compact Source: 2nd reward for defeating The Unknown Resonant.

title: Blueprint: Untapped Coffee Cup
description: *Health regenerates slowly outside of combat.* I don't think I like coffee, but the researchers drank it all the time. Creates: Coffee Cup Source: Reward for completing the Last Taxi mini-quest chain.

title: Blueprint: Untapped Trusted Spanner
description: *Increases Dylan's Raw Damage output by 15%.* A wrench that's well worn and used. Creates: Trusted Spanner Source: Reward for completing the Notes: Every Dog Has Her Day mini-quest chain.

title: Blueprint: Untapped Fork
description: *Increases Dylan's Sharp Damage output by 15%.* Could be a pretty good weapon in a pinch. Creates: Fork Source: Reward for completing the Notes: Mapping the New New York mini-quest chain.

title: Blueprint: Untapped Scrunchie
description: *Increases Damage done by Primary Melee weapon forms by 10%.* Jesse had one just like this. She said it was lucky. Creates: Scrunchie Source: Reward for completing the Unsupervised Science mini-quest chain.

title: Blueprint: Untapped Weekend Crossword
description: *Increases Damage done by Combo Finishers by +15%.* Grandma loved these, said they used to keep her mind sharp. Creates: The Weekend Crossword Source: Reward for completing the Zoe's Favorites mini-quest chain.

title: Blueprint: Untapped Unfinished Lollipop
description: *Increases Damage done by Secondary Melee weapon forms by 10%.* Smells like apple and…blueberry? Creates: Unfinished Lollipop Source: Reward for completing the Sketchbook mini-quest chain.

title: Blueprint: Untapped 1996 Commemorative Coin
description: *Health Elements will become more effective and restore a larger amount Health.* Minted for an occasion no one can quite remember. Creates: 1996 Commemorative Coin Source: Reward for defeating The Unknown Resonant.

title: Welcome to Manhattan
description: *I've made a deal with the FBC. They let me out temporarily, and I help them fight. They never would have agreed if the situation wasn't desperate. Zoe will be my handler. She'll give me my first assignment.* Category: Main Story: Contain the Crisis Rewards: - 1st: 1x Living Shard, 600 Zone XP - 2nd: 1500x Source, 800 Zone XP

title: Recursions and Iterations
description: *After the disaster with the CFD, the Sinkhole's been Patterned even deeper. Now Pope needs my help.* Category: Main Story: Protect the Dimension Rewards: - 1st: 1x Living Shard, 1x Prime Candidate Restraint Suit - 2nd: 1500x Source - 600 Zone XP each

title: The Beginning
description: *My birth certificate has been re-issued and I'm officially an FBC consultant. I even have my own apartment in the city now. There's still a lot to do in Manhattan, but visiting Jesse comes first.* Category: Main Story: Epilogue Rewards: - 1st: 1x Untapped Pickpocket's Tool, 800 Zone XP - 2nd: 1500x Source, 1200 Zone XP

title: Power Lines
description: *The CFD needs a lot of power. A maintenance team was sent to reroute power from the city grid through the subway stations, but they disappeared, along with an entire subway station. Arish wants me to finish the job.* Category: Main Story: Contain the Crisis Rewards: - 1st: 1x Living Shard, 600 Zone XP - 2nd: 1500x Source, 750 Zone XP

title: Evacuation Procedures
description: *After the Evac Site was overrun, Hiss tremors began emanating from the building. I need to find out what's going on so we can put a stop to it.* Category: Main Story: Contain the Crisis Rewards: - 1st: 1x Living Shard, 1x Agent Uniform - 2nd: 1500x Source - 600 Zone XP each

title: Arish's Briefing
description: *Arish wants to see me in the Field Office. We couldn't stop the tremors at the Evac Site, but apparently he has a plan.* Category: Main Story: Contain the Crisis

title: Enemy of My Enemy
description: *The CFD is almost complete. But the tremors at the Evac Site are still getting worse. We're running out of time...* Category: Main Story: Contain the Crisis Rewards: - 1st: 1x Living Shard, 1x Bureau Rain Gear: Torn - 2nd: 1500x Source - 600 Zone XP each

title: Into the Sinkhole
description: *The active Pattern resonance the CFD needs can be found at the bottom of the Sinkhole. We just have to harness it. But the team the FBC sent down to place the probe relays didn't get far. Hopefully I'll have better luck...* Category: Main Story: Contain the Crisis Rewards: - 1st: 1x Living Shard - 2nd: 1500x Source - 600 Zone XP each

title: The Subway Fault
description: *Patterning in the Evacuation Zone's subway tunnels could lead me to another Fault. It's worth taking a look...* Category: Main Story: Search for Jesse Rewards: - 1x Living Shard - 600 Zone XP

title: Orientation
description: *Something's gone wrong in the Oldest House. What did I wake up to?* Category: Main Story: Wake Up Rewards: - 1st: 2000x Source, 1x Living Shard, 2x Reset Item, 1x Untapped Badge 11-60, 380 Zone XP - 2nd: 2500x Source, 1x Reset Item, 800 Zone XP

title: The House in Distress
description: *Somehow deep underground, I saw a vision: A Dimensional Fault inside the Oldest House. I asked Zoe to meet me at the entrance to the Prime Candidate training grounds. I don't think I can do this alone...* Category: Main Story: Protect the Dimension Rewards: - 1st: 1x Living Shard, 600 Zone XP - 2nd: 1500x Source, 1000 Zone XP

title: The Hedron Link
description: *After the ritual was interrupted, the source of the Patterning entered our dimension: It's a Hedron, an extradimensional resonant force. It will Pattern everything it finds, starting with the Oldest House. Unless I stop it.* Category: Main Story: Protect the Dimension Rewards: - 1st: 1x Living Shard, 600 Zone XP - 2nd: 1500x Source, 1000 Zone XP

title: The Incursion Fault
description: *The West Incursion Zone is full of Patterning. Something's going on there, even beyond the chaotic state the rest of the city is in...* Category: Main Story: Search for Jesse Rewards: - 1st: 1x Living Shard - 2nd: 1500x Source - 600 Zone XP each

title: Sever the Hedron Links
description: *After destroying the first Hedron Link, two more slammed into the Patterned city above the Oldest House. I'll disrupt the Pattern and sever both. Then I'll go after the Hedron itself.* Category: Main Story: Defeat the Hedron Rewards: - 1st: 1x Living Shard, 1000 Zone XP - 2nd: 1x Living Shard, 1200 Zone XP

title: The Underpass Fault
description: *A tenuous vision of Jesse is leading me towards an island where the Patterned orange pipes in the Underpass converge. Maybe I can still find her...* Category: Main Story: Search for Jesse Rewards: - 1x Living Shard - 600 Zone XP

title: The Complete Set
description: *Altered Speakers loose in Manhattan? This can’t be good.* Category: Side Stories Rewards: - 1st: 1x Untapped Bout Guard, 400 Zone XP - 2nd: 1000x Source, 750 Zone XP Solution: ||Follow the quest objectives to find and collect all of the speakers and the subwoofer. After returning them all to the auction house, place them in the following places. 1) Place a speaker on the glass door at the bottom of the stairs, resting over three flight cases. 2) Place a speaker on the black rock slabs on the pallet truck that's on the raised platform on the north side of the auction hall. 3) Place a speaker on the carved wooden bench on the upper level of the auction hall between the two generators, opposite where you pick the speakers up from. 4) Place a speaker on the blue tarp hanging over the balcony on the upper level of the auction hall, opposite where you pick the speakers up. 5) Place the subwoofer in the water spill next to the sofa where you pick it up from. 6) Run to each of the speakers in turn and turn them off. You need to be quick or they'll reset. 7) Once all speakers are off, speak to the woman next to the subwoofer, then interact with the subwoofer to decide her fate.||

title: Crossing the Threshold
description: *I found a body with an exploded head. I need to figure out what's going on before more people turn up dead...* Category: Side Stories Rewards: - 1st: 1x Untapped Practice Knot, 1x [Sensory Restraint Hood](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953808), 400 Zone XP - 2nd: 1000x Source, 800 Zone XP

title: Carbon Copy: Part II
description: *Something is going on with the twins that were evacuated from the Park. I need to make sure they're okay.* Category: Side Stories Rewards: - 1st: 1x Untapped Medical Alert Bands, 500 Zone XP - 2nd: 1000x Source, 250 Zone XP

title: Zoe's Briefing
description: *The Hiss and the Patterning aren't the only problems in Manhattan. Zoe wants to brief me on what's going on.* Category: Side Stories

title: Panopticon Service Request
description: *Langston says the Maintenance team left the Field Panopticon's security system non-functional. He's asked me to fix the Security Terminal so we can move one of the Altered Items safely.* Category: Side Stories Rewards: - 1st: 1x Untapped Feeding Bottle, 1x [Aramid Work Clothes](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953807), 300 Zone XP - 2nd: 1000x Source, 800 Zone XP

title: Urban Survival
description: *Traps have been laid around a parking garage in the Evacuation Zone, but it wasn't the FBC...* Category: Side Stories Rewards: - 1st: 1x Untapped Heart Monitor, 1x Plate Carrier M1 - 2nd: 1000x Source - 250 Zone XP each

title: Into the Valley of Death
description: *Langston needs help with a mission that is clearly very important to him. Something about his apartment?* Category: Side Stories Rewards: - 1st: 1x Untapped Catnip Toy - 2nd: 1000x Source - 250 Zone XP each

title: Carbon Copy
description: *In the Park, I found somebody named Heidi, who won't evacuate until she finds her twin sister. Maybe I can help.* Category: Side Stories Rewards: - 1st: 1x Untapped Mother's Locket, 500 Zone XP - 2nd: 1000x Source, 250 Zone XP

title: Carbon Copy: Part III
description: *I thought Heidi was dead, but when I left the apartment, I bumped into her, or copies of her, or... of Hannah?* Category: Side Stories Rewards: - 1st: 1x Untapped Medical Alert Bands, 500 Zone XP - 2nd: 1000x Source, 250 Zone XP

title: New Growth
description: *Dr. Raya Underhill, the head researcher of the Mold, has gone missing. Her work is important, especially now. I hope I find her still alive.* Category: Side Stories Rewards: - 1st: 1x Untapped Brass Dusters, 500 Zone XP - 2nd: 1000x Source, 250 Zone XP

title: The Party Won’t Stop
description: *There's music coming from one of the apartment blocks in the West Incursion Zone. In these circumstances? No way that's normal.* Category: Side Stories Rewards: - 1st: 1x Untapped Bar Blade, 1x Varsity Jacket - 2nd: 1000x Source - 250 Zone XP each Note: Completing this quest without anyone dying rewards the Be What You Want to Be achievement. If you make a mistake, reload an earlier save. Solution: || Pick the lyrics in this order: 1. gasoline 2. stress 3. so fleeting 4. too long 5. move 6. fear 7. everything 8. higher and higher 9. shout ||

title: Taxi
description: Solution: || 1. Answer the ringing phone and speak to Mila. 2. Find the only taxi with an illuminated fare light and get in it. 3. Approach each taxi and get in the one that doesn't turn it's light off when you approach. 4. Approach each taxi and look at the other taxis as you do. One of them will light up when you approach the wrong taxis. Find and enter the taxi that is lighting up.||

title: Taxi
description: Solution: || 1. Answer the ringing phone and speak to Mila. 2. Look for street lights next to the taxis. Enter the taxi where the light is blinking. 3. Enter the taxi where the light is not blinking. 4. All the lights are blinking, look for the one that's out of sync with the rest and enter it.||

title: Taxi
description: Solution: || 1. Answer the ringing phone and speak to Mila. 2. The lights on the taxis are blinking. Enter the taxi that is out-of-sync with the rest. 3. Each taxi is lighting up in sequence. Enter the taxi that flashes twice instead of once. 4. Each taxi is lighting up in sequence. Enter the taxi that never lights up.||

title: Taxi
description: Solution: || 1. Reach the payphone and talk to Mila. 2. Break the mold spores around the taxi to find the missing parts and bring them to the taxi, then enter the taxi. 3. Repeat step 2, some parts do not belong to the taxi this time. Enter the taxi once reassembled. 4. Defeat the 3 smaller spores hidden in the mold, then the larger spore on-top of the taxi. Once clear, find the correct parts for the taxi to reassemble it and enter the taxi for a third and final time. ||

title: Taxi
description: Prerequisite: Gravity Anomaly {{gravity width=16}} Solution: || 1) Find the ringing payphone and speak to Mila. 2) Go to the taxis and get in the one where the streetlight is flashing. 3) Get in the taxi where the streetlight is not flashing. 4) Get in the taxi where the streetlight is out of sync with the rest.||

title: Taxi
description: Location: On the road to the right of the Patterned Evac Building. Solution: || 1. Find the ringing phone and answer it. 2. Find the taxis parked in the street and pick up the work light. 3. Use this to cast light on each taxi and look at the shape of the shadow cast on the wall. 4. Find the taxi that has the correct shadow of a taxi and get in. Repeat this three times. ||

title: Taxi
description: Solution: || 1. Find and answer the phone and talk to Mila, then find the taxis. 2. Get in the taxi that keeps its light on when the streetlights go out. 3. Get in the taxi that does not keep its light on when the streetlights go out. 4. Get in the taxi that does not have it's light on when the streetlights are on. ||

description: Destination: [Elevator to Lobby](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=952884#L)

title: Exit from the Astral Fortress
description: Leads to [The Underpass](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=956862#L)

title: Sketchbook: Rooftop Oasis
description: Arrange the [Bird Statue](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953830#L), [Bird Statue](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953831#L), [Bird Statue](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953832#L), [Potted Plant](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953833#L), [Potted Plant](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953834#L) and [Potted Plant](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953835#L) in the correct order to complete.

title: Atlantis Cafe Secret Room
description: Solution: ||Turn the power breaker on and then switch on each appliance in order of size. 1. Radio (opposite side of the room) 2. Coffee Machine 3. Bigger Coffee Machine 4. Soda Dispenser 5. Microwave 6. Fridge Once complete, a secret entrance will open.||

title: Sketchbook: Beach Day
description: Arrange the [Camping Chair](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953838#L) and [Umbrella](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953839#L) in the correct order to complete.

title: Secret: Laundry Puzzle
description: Solution: Each horizontal row on the [Laundry Puzzle](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=951649) note corresponds to a row of washing machines, starting from the east wall and moving west. Turn the washing machines on (1) or off (0) depending on the number shown on the grid. As soon as the correct combination is activate, a secret wall will open in the back room.

title: Sketchbook: The Cat Picnic
description: Arrange the [Black Cat Statue](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953851#L), [Picnic Basket](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953850#L) and [Ginger Cat Statue](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953852#L) in the correct order to complete.

title: Sketchbook: Live on Stage
description: Arrange the [Cymbal](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953855#L), [Bass Guitar](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953856#L), [Guitar](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953857#L), [Keyboard](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953858#L) and [Microphone](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953859#L) in the correct order to complete.

title: Charlie Beecham Art Gallery
description: Inside the art gallery there's a note [Paintings Sold](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=951738). There are four sets of paintings each with a light switch to toggle which one is illuminated. You need to light the paintings that best match the words on the note. Solution: ||Facing the reception desk from the door. - Left Wall: Middle painting - Front Right Wall: Middle painting - Back Right Wall: Left painting - Back Wall: Left painting ||

title: Sketchbook: Robotics
description: Arrange the [Robot Arm](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953875#L), [Robot Leg](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953876#L), [Robot Arm](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953877#L), [Robot Leg](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953878#L) and [Spotlight](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953879#L) in the correct order to complete.

title: Sketchbook: Dream House
description: Arrange the [Plywood Wall](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953881#L), [Potted Plant](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953882#L), [Planter](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953883#L), [Cat Statue](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953884#L), [Dog Statue](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953885#L) and [Plywood Roof](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953886#L) in the correct order to complete.

title: Sketchbook: The Dragon and The Knight Sketch
description: Location: On the station platform of the Park Valley subway. Arrange the [Traffic Cone](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953895#L), [Traffic Cone](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953896#L), [Pizza Slice](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953897#L), [Pizza Slice](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953898#L), [Fence Cover](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953899#L) and [Fence Cover](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953900#L) in the correct order to complete.

title: Atlantis Cafe Secret Basement
description: Solution: ||Check the four tables listed on the [Table reservations](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=951762) list and then check each of those tables in order. The menu on each table corresponds to an item on the [Coffee menu](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=951763). Enter this combination on the cash register to open the secret wall.||

title: Urban Fresh Mart Secret Door
description: Solution: || 1. Activate the soda dispenser 2. Remember order of lights blinking (3-1-2-1) 3. Reverse code (1-2-1-3) 4. Activate cash register and enter the code ||

title: Sketchbook: Halloween Party
description: Arrange the [Ghost](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953916#L), [Pumpkins](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953917#L), [Inflatable](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953918#L) and [Skeleton](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953919#L) in the correct order to complete.

title: Pulse Fitness Secret Basement
description: Solution: ||Based on the [Workout Instructions](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=951874), follow this sequence: 1. Set the treadmill speed to 0.5 mph. 2. Set the spin bike speed to 15 mph. 3. Take a snack from the vending machine. 4. Set the treatmill speed to 15 mph. 5. Set the spin bike speed to 0.5 mph. Once done in the correct order, a secret wall will open near the spin bike.|| {{gravity width=16}} Gravity Anomoly: Requires use of inverted gravity to access

title: Sketchbook: Art Exhibition
description: Location: Inside the KÖNSTIG art gallery. Arrange the [Metal Ball](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953927#L), [Laptop](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953928#L), [Toilet](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953929#L) and [Vacuum Cleaner](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953930#L) in the correct order to complete.

title: Sketchbook: Game Night
description: Arrange the [Figurine](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953934#L), [Figurine](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953935#L), [Candlestick](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953936#L), [Pizza](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953937#L), [Mannequin](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953938#L) and [Figurine](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953939#L) in the correct order to complete.

title: Sketchbook: Space Adventure
description: Arrange the [Astronaut Figurine](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953952#L), [Astronaut Figurine](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953953#L), [Flag](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953954#L), [Alien Figurine](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953955#L) and [Spaceship](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953956#L) in the correct order to complete.

title: Hot Dog Stand
description: Note: Observe and report the hot dog stand to Zoe. Afterward, the document, [The Hot Dog Incident](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953372#L), will appear. If the hot dog stand cannot be interacted with, you will need to progress the story past [Into the Sinkhole](https://mapgenie.io/control-resonant/maps/district?locationIds=953891)
